question: Snails is an example of which of the phylum of animal kingdom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mollusca**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mollusca:-**

 
 
• **Molluscs are characterized by their soft bodies, which are often protected by a hard shell. **
 
• They also have a unique digestive system that includes a muscular foot, a radula (a tongue-like organ with rows of teeth), and a gizzard. 
 
• Molluscs are divided into several classes, including the Gastropoda (snails and slugs), Bivalvia (clams and oysters), Cephalopoda (squids, octopuses, and nautiluses), and Polyplacophora (chitons).
 
• **Snails are an example of the phylum Mollusca.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Arthropoda:-**

 
 
• **It is the largest phylum in the animal kingdom, comprising about 80% of all known animal species. **
 
• Arthropods live in all habitats on Earth, from the sea to the air, and from the poles to the tropics.
 
 
 
• **Protochordates:-**
 
 
• **These are an informal category of animals that are closely related to vertebrates. **
 
• They are invertebrates, but they share many of the same characteristics as vertebrates, such as a notochord (a flexible rod that runs along the back of the animal), a dorsal nerve cord, and pharyngeal gill slits.
 
 
 
• **Annelida:-**
 
 
• **It is a phylum of segmented worms, with over 22,000 extant species including ragworms, earthworms, and leeches. **
 
• The species exist in and have adapted to various ecologies – some in marine environments as distinct as tidal zones and hydrothermal vents, others in fresh water, and yet others in moist terrestrial environments.
